scripts.dev:admin:reset: docker compose run --rm -e AIRTEK_ALLOW_DEV_ADMIN_RESET=true platform-maintenance reset-development-admin
scripts.build:production: pnpm --filter @airtek/contracts build && pnpm --filter @airtek/ui build && pnpm --filter @airtek/web build && pnpm --filter @airtek/admin build:production
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @airtek/contracts build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:workspace-tools && pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:rust
scripts.check:production: pnpm check:source-lines && pnpm check:postgres-boundary && pnpm build:production && node scripts/assert-production-isolation.mjs && node scripts/assert-admin-ui-boundary.mjs
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm test:workspace-tools && pnpm check:workspace-hygiene && node scripts/assert-architecture.mjs && pnpm check:source-lines
scripts.generate:contracts: node scripts/generate-openapi.mjs && node scripts/generate-openapi-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-admin-operation-matrix.mjs && pnpm --filter @airtek/contracts typecheck
scripts.check:contracts: node scripts/generate-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-openapi-runtime.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-admin-operation-matrix.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @airtek/contracts typecheck
